items.name: Weekend Taster Camp
items.alt: Surfers walking to the water at sunrise in Arugam Bay
items.blurb: A long weekend to find out why people cancel their onward flights. Two nights in a sea-view cabana, four hours of coaching, and every meal handled.
includes: 2 × surf lessons with a certified coach

items.name: 7-Day Surf Camp
items.alt: Sea-view cabana terrace at Light House Surf Camp
items.blurb: Our signature week, and the one guests come back for. Daily coaching at the break that suits your level, Ayurvedic bodywork to keep you paddling, and a table that fills up at sunset.

items.name: 10-Day Pro Trip
items.alt: Aerial view of the point break at Arugam Bay
items.blurb: For surfers chasing real progression. We follow the swell up and down the coast — Whiskey Point, Peanut Farm, Okanda — and film every session.
includes: Surf-safari day trips up the coast
